newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong's confidence on the rise - poll.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's confidence on the rise - poll.

text.p: Confidence in Hong Kong's future after China takes over this year is on the rise among the territory's 6.3 million people, a government poll suggested on Friday.

The January survey by the Home Affairs Branch found 73 percent of 1,506 respondents were confident that Hong Kong would continue to be prosperous and stable after the transition, a rise of 13 percentage points from a similar poll three months earlier.
Asked whether Hong Kong's situation would actually improve over the next 12 months, 25 percent said yes, up from 15 percent, while 45 percent believed it would stay the same.
Britain returns the territory to China at midnight on June 30 after more than 150 years of colonial rule.
Hong Kong has been jolted lately by Beijing's plans to abolish the elected legislature and dilute human rights laws.
